Truck history checks

Every truck undergoes a basic history check, based on the registration supplied. We'll never advertise a truck where the check returned shows it was stolen, scrapped or written off beyond repair. You can also get a 27-point independent report about your truck’s background with our vehicle check tool for complete peace of mind.
